in_sanskrit.name: Mokibul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Giver of Liberation
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mokibul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mokibul is a Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Moksha’ meaning liberation and ‘Bul’ meaning giver. This name is bestowed upon a child to bless them with the ability to bestow the gift of liberation and enlightenment upon others.
